label: Synthetic SaaS MSA deviation playbook (illustrative positions, not legal advice)

rules.standard_position: Undisputed invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of receipt.
rules.fallback_position: Up to forty-five (45) days with Finance approval.
rules.rationale: The draft extends the payment period beyond the standard thirty days.
rules.exception_obligation: Notify Finance of the extended payment period before the order form is issued.

rules.deviation_pattern: at any time and without prior notice
rules.standard_text: once in any twelve (12) month period on thirty (30) days' prior written notice, during business hours and subject to Supplier's confidentiality requirements
rules.standard_position: One audit per twelve-month period on thirty days' prior written notice.
rules.fallback_position: An additional audit after a confirmed security incident affecting Customer data.
rules.rationale: The draft grants an unrestricted audit right without notice or frequency limit.
rules.exception_obligation: Brief Security Operations on the agreed audit procedure and record the audit contact.

rules.deviation_pattern: Supplier shall not engage any subprocessor for the processing of Customer Personal Data\.
rules.standard_text: Supplier may engage the subprocessors listed in Annex 2 and shall give Customer thirty (30) days' prior notice of any intended addition or replacement, during which Customer may object on reasonable grounds.
rules.standard_position: General written authorisation for listed subprocessors with a notice and objection period.
rules.fallback_position: A shorter list of subprocessors agreed for this customer, recorded in Annex 2.
rules.rationale: The draft prohibits every subprocessor, which the service architecture cannot meet.
rules.exception_obligation: Maintain the customer-specific subprocessor list in Annex 2 and the notification register.

rules.standard_position: Aggregate liability is capped at one hundred percent of the Fees paid in the preceding twelve months.
rules.fallback_position: Up to two hundred percent (200%) with General Counsel approval.
rules.rationale: The draft raises the aggregate liability cap above the standard position.
rules.exception_obligation: Record the agreed liability cap in the customer commitments register and inform Finance and the insurer contact.

rules.standard_text: Neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss, loss of profit or loss of data, except where liability cannot be limited or excluded by law.
rules.standard_position: Indirect and consequential loss is excluded for both parties within mandatory law.
rules.fallback_position: A mutual exclusion limited to loss of profit.
rules.rationale: The draft contains no exclusion of indirect or consequential loss.
rules.exception_obligation: Record the missing exclusion as an accepted risk in the deal approval note.

rules.clause_pattern: features described in the Product Roadmap
rules.deviation_pattern: Supplier shall deliver the features described in the Product Roadmap no later than \d{1,2} [A-Z][a-z]+ \d{4}\.
rules.standard_text: Any product roadmap is provided for information only and is not a commitment to deliver any feature or functionality.
rules.standard_position: Roadmap statements are informational and create no delivery obligation.
rules.fallback_position: A non-binding quarterly roadmap review meeting.
rules.rationale: The draft converts the product roadmap into a dated delivery obligation.
rules.exception_obligation: Obtain Product leadership sign-off on any dated delivery commitment and track it as a customer commitment.

rules.standard_position: No most-favoured-customer pricing commitment is given.
rules.fallback_position: A price-hold for the initial term of this order only.
rules.rationale: The draft adds a most-favoured-customer pricing clause.
rules.exception_obligation: Record the pricing commitment with Revenue Operations and set a renewal review date.
